text:
mike: Heads-up — Redwood + Voltix Systems joint perf run idea. Goal: quantify perf/W and steady-state throughput across our kernel tuning knobs, plus validate telemetry schema. Thinking 2-week sweep in Voltix lab w/ our benchmark harness. Who can own config + telemetry handshake?

elisabeth (Voltix): Happy to run on our side. We can provide rack power strips and DC measurements. Suggested dates: next Tue-Fri window available. Need the exact metrics and file formats.

mike: Awesome. Core metrics: avg token throughput (tokens/s), p99 latency, GPU package power (W), host CPU power (W), energy-per-token, mem bandwidth util, and kernel variant tag. Output format: newline-delimited JSON per run. Also need per-step KV cache hit rate.

raj: For kernel variants we'll expose three flags: --kernel=baseline|fused|fused-quant, --seq-len, --batch. Also add --prefetch=on|off. I can drop a sample runner command.

raj: ```
./bench-runner --model redwood-mini --kernel fused-quant --seq-len 512 --batch 8 --profiling nvml,perf --output results/voltix_run.json
```

natalie: We'll map results to our eval set. Need a stable prompt set and throughput target. I'll push a small prompt corpus (50 prompts) to the shared S3 bucket and a evaluation script to score perplexity + token error.

henry: Infra notes: Voltix nodes will be on isolated VLAN. Need port ranges for bench-control and telemetry (grpc 50051). Also request we schedule a short canary the first day for smoke checks. I can own the runbook.

elisabeth (Voltix): Confirmed VLAN and power telemetry access. Voltage/current sensors available as CSV with timestamps. We can ship CSV or push to our Influx endpoint — which do you prefer?

mike: Prefer CSV newline-JSON to keep storage simple for now. Include timestamp (epoch ms), host_id, run_id, power_w, socket_temp_c. We'll convert.

natalie: For baseline comparisons, we'll need a quantized model variant and FP16. I'll prepare two pinned model hashes and add to the bench config.

raj: Quick ask: can Voltix expose raw kernel logs for 1 failing run? kernel-debug=/tmp/klog.txt. Helps debug perf cliffs.

elisabeth (Voltix): Yes, we can collect /tmp/klog.txt and SFTP it to the shared bucket.

mike: Proposed timeline: prep this week (configs + prompt set), run next Tue-Thu, collect and share results Fri, follow-up sync Mon for findings and press-coordination. Is that agreeable?

henry: Works for infra. I'll draft runbook and smoke checklist by EOD tomorrow.

elisabeth (Voltix): Works for us. I'll reserve lab and power metering.

natalie: I'll drop the prompt set + scoring script to s3://redwood-partner-shared/voltix/ by end of day.

raj: I'll add bench matrix to the repo and make sure runner emits fields: run_id, kernel, seq_len, batch, tokens, duration_ms, avg_tps, p50, p95, p99, energy_j, energy_per_token.

bench-bot: bench-run scheduled: 2024-06-18T09:00Z -> voltix-smoke-run (run_id=rvx-20240618-smoke). I'll post results.json when finished. :robot_face:

mike: Perfect. After initial sweep, we'll pick 2 tuning knobs for deeper exploration (prefetch + fused-quant) and draft PR with recommended kernel defaults for Hosted vs Dedicated. Also flag any thermal headroom items for partner announcement notes.

elisabeth (Voltix): Noted — we'll also instrument thermal throttling flags on the board. If anything looks off, we'll pause and file an ops incident.

mike: Thanks all — I'll create calendar invite and add the runbook link in this thread. :thumbsup:
